item.title: Peppa Pig Introduces Deaf Character (and Accompanying Toys) for New Season
item.description: After revealing that Peppa's brother George is moderately deaf, Hasbro is introducing a new toy that features the character wearing a hearing aid

item.title: ‘Heated Rivalry’ Book Sales Boost HarperCollins to Quarterly Revenue Record
item.description: "Ice hockey stereotypes are melting away as players pursue each other, and a puck," News Corp. CEO Robert Thomson told Wall Street analysts Thursday.

item.title: Can New York Stop Ticket Scalpers From Gouging Concertgoers?
item.description: A state senator will introduce legislation Friday that, if passed, would place a price cap preventing scalpers from reselling tickets for greater than their face value.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie’s Brother Addresses Suspected Kidnappers of Mother Nancy Guthrie in New Video
item.description: "Whoever is out there holding our mother, we want to hear from you. We haven't heard anything directly," Camron Guthrie says on Instagram.

item.title: Mark Ruffalo Tells Kevin O’Leary to “STFU” After He Slams Billie Eilish’s Anti-ICE Grammys Speech
item.description: The 'Shark Tank' star warned celebrities who get political, such as the Grammy-winning singer, to "shut your mouth."
